topics.topic: Required state and assertions after re-registering an ended identity
questions: Must “no project” show both an empty granted set and no active project, as A11-2 requires, and how must those two facts be asserted?
Must this test show an empty granted set, no active project, no pending request and access version 1, or does “no project” assert only one of those facts?
Must this test separately show both facts required by A11-2—an empty granted set and no active project—or does “no project” mean only one of them?

quotes: register(x) after end(x) => granted(x) = {} and active(x) = none   -- A11-2

2. Registering the ended identity again answers a session with no project.
   Shows A11-2. [witness: verification:registry_a11_reregistered_ended_identity_empty]

1. A session's access version is 1 at registration and moves by one with each
   accepted action that changes its granted set, its active project or its
   pending request (M06) — a project leaving the set by its erasure included
   (R0-61). One action moves it once, however many of these it changes:
   granting a project and making it active is one move.
judgement.why: The test explicitly says it shows A11-2, which requires both an empty granted set and no active project; pending-request absence is not part of A11-2, and access version 1 is separately decided by A12, while the mechanics of individual assertions belong to factory_checks.
options: Require an empty granted set and no active project as A11-2 states.
Also require no pending request and access version 1 in this A11 test.
Require only one meaning of “no project”.
consequences: A11's Required test must show both facts in A11-2, but need not duplicate unrelated new-session facts or prescribe the Factory check's assertion mechanism.
